spots.name: 开平自力村
spots.location: 广东省江门市开平市塘口镇
spots.open_info: 开放时间以景区当日公告为准
spots.intro: 自力村碉楼群位于广东省开平市塘口镇，是世界文化遗产“开平碉楼与村落”的核心片区之一。村中现存十五座碉楼，大多建于二十世纪二三十年代，由旅居海外的侨胞为防匪患、保家园而兴建，集防卫、居住与中西建筑艺术于一体。
spots.history: 开平碉楼与村落于2007年被列入《世界遗产名录》，是广东省第一处世界文化遗产。自力村村落由安和里、合安里、永安里三条方姓自然村组成，保存了民国时期侨乡典型的碉楼与居庐建筑群。电影《让子弹飞》曾在此取景，使自力村广为人知。
spots.narrate: 自力村，位于广东省开平市塘口镇，是世界文化遗产开平碉楼与村落的核心片区之一。村里现存十五座碉楼，大多建于上世纪二三十年代，是当年旅居海外的侨胞为了防匪患、保家园而修建的，集防卫、居住和中西建筑艺术于一体。其中最著名的是铭石楼，电影《让子弹飞》曾经在这里取景。漫步村中，碉楼、居庐与稻田、竹林相映成趣，可以感受到浓郁的侨乡风情。

en.name: Zili Village (Kaiping Diaolou and Villages)
en.open_info: Opening hours are subject to the scenic area's daily notice
en.intro: The Zili Village Diaolou Cluster is located in Tangkou Town, Kaiping, Guangdong Province, and is one of the core areas of the World Cultural Heritage site 'Kaiping Diaolou and Villages'. The village preserves fifteen diaolou, or watchtowers, most built in the 1920s and 1930s by overseas Chinese to defend their homes against bandits, combining defense, residence and Chinese-Western architectural art.
en.history: Kaiping Diaolou and Villages was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2007, becoming the first World Cultural Heritage site in Guangdong Province. The village consists of three Fang-family hamlets and retains a typical group of Republican-era diaolou and residential buildings of the overseas-Chinese homeland. Parts of the film 'Let the Bullets Fly' were shot here, making Zili Village widely known.
en.narrate: Zili Village is located in Tangkou Town, Kaiping, Guangdong Province. It is one of the core areas of the World Cultural Heritage site Kaiping Diaolou and Villages. The village preserves fifteen diaolou, or watchtowers, most built in the 1920s and 1930s by overseas Chinese to defend their homes against bandits; they combine defense, residence and Chinese-Western architectural art. The most famous is Mingshi Lou, where parts of the film Let the Bullets Fly were shot. Walking through the village, the diaolou and residences set against the rice fields and bamboo groves offer a vivid sense of the overseas-Chinese homeland.

spots.name: 赤坎古镇
aliases: 广东赤坎古镇侨乡国际旅游度假区
spots.location: 广东省江门市开平市赤坎镇
spots.open_info: 开放时间以景区当日公告为准
spots.intro: 赤坎古镇位于广东省开平市赤坎镇、潭江河畔，开埠建墟已有三百多年历史。古镇沿江保留着六百多座南洋与欧陆风情的骑楼，是全国规模最大、界面最连续、保存最完整的侨乡古骑楼建筑群之一。
spots.history: 二十世纪初，赤坎的关氏与司徒氏两大家族争相在镇上兴建骑楼、学校和图书馆，其中关族图书馆始建于1929年、1931年落成，司徒氏通俗图书馆亦为华侨捐资兴建，使赤坎赢得“万国建筑博物馆”之名。2023年1月，广东赤坎古镇侨乡国际旅游度假区正式试运营，成为中国首个以华侨文化为主题的大型度假区。
spots.narrate: 赤坎古镇，位于广东省开平市赤坎镇、潭江河畔，开埠建墟已经有三百多年历史。古镇沿江保留着六百多座骑楼，南洋和欧陆风情交融，是全国规模最大、界面最连续、保存最完整的侨乡古骑楼建筑群之一。二十世纪初，镇上的关氏和司徒氏两大家族争相修建骑楼、学校和图书馆，著名的关族图书馆、司徒氏通俗图书馆都出自那个年代，也让赤坎有了万国建筑博物馆的美誉。如今这里已成为广东赤坎古镇侨乡国际旅游度假区，是了解华侨文化和侨批文化的好去处。

en.name: Chikan Ancient Town
en.open_info: Opening hours are subject to the scenic area's daily notice
en.intro: Chikan Ancient Town lies on the bank of the Tan River in Chikan Town, Kaiping, Guangdong Province, and has a history of more than three hundred years as a market town. Along the river it preserves more than six hundred qilou, or arcade buildings, blending Southeast Asian and European styles, forming one of the largest and best-preserved overseas-Chinese arcade street complexes in China.
en.history: In the early twentieth century, the two great clans of Chikan, the Guan and the Situ, competed in building arcades, schools and libraries. The Guan Clan Library was begun in 1929 and completed in 1931, and the Situ Popular Library was also funded by overseas Chinese, earning Chikan the name 'Museum of World Architecture'. In January 2023, the Guangdong Chikan Ancient Town Overseas-Chinese International Resort opened for trial operation, becoming China's first large resort themed on overseas-Chinese culture.
en.narrate: Chikan Ancient Town lies on the bank of the Tan River in Chikan Town, Kaiping, Guangdong Province, with more than three hundred years of history as a market town. Along the river it preserves more than six hundred qilou, or arcade buildings, blending Southeast Asian and European styles; it is one of the largest and best-preserved overseas-Chinese arcade street complexes in China. In the early twentieth century, the two great clans, the Guan and the Situ, competed in building arcades, schools and libraries. The famous Guan Clan Library and Situ Popular Library date from that era, giving Chikan the name Museum of World Architecture. Today it is the Guangdong Chikan Ancient Town Overseas-Chinese International Resort, a great place to learn about overseas-Chinese and qiaopi culture.

spots.name: 梁启超故居
spots.location: 广东省江门市新会区茶坑村
spots.open_info: 开放时间以景区当日公告为准
spots.intro: 梁启超故居位于广东省江门市新会区茶坑村，建于清代光绪年间，是一座青砖土瓦的岭南民居，由故居、怡堂书室和回廊等建筑组成，建筑面积四百多平方米，现为全国重点文物保护单位。
spots.history: 梁启超（1873—1929）是近代中国著名的思想家、政治家、教育家、史学家和文学家，曾与康有为共同领导戊戌变法，写下《少年中国说》等名篇。故居所在的茶坑村是他的出生地，如今设有梁启超故居纪念馆，供人们缅怀这位近代启蒙先驱。
spots.narrate: 梁启超故居，位于广东省江门市新会区茶坑村，建于清代光绪年间，是一座青砖土瓦的岭南民居，由故居、怡堂书室和回廊等建筑组成，建筑面积四百多平方米，现在是全国重点文物保护单位。梁启超是近代中国著名的思想家、政治家、教育家和文学家，曾经和康有为一起领导戊戌变法，还写下了《少年中国说》等名篇。这里是他出生和成长的地方，如今建有梁启超故居纪念馆，供人们缅怀这位近代启蒙先驱。

en.name: Former Residence of Liang Qichao
en.location: Chakeng Village, Xinhui District, Jiangmen, Guangdong
en.open_info: Opening hours are subject to the scenic area's daily notice
en.intro: The Former Residence of Liang Qichao is located in Chakeng Village, Xinhui District, Jiangmen, Guangdong Province. Built during the Guangxu period of the Qing dynasty, it is a Lingnan dwelling of grey bricks and clay tiles, consisting of the residence, the Yitang Study and corridors, with a floor area of more than four hundred square meters. It is now a Major Historical and Cultural Site Protected at the National Level.
en.history: Liang Qichao (1873-1929) was a renowned modern Chinese thinker, politician, educator, historian and writer. He led the Hundred Days' Reform together with Kang Youwei and wrote celebrated works such as 'The Youth of China'. Chakeng Village is his birthplace; today the site also houses the Liang Qichao Memorial Hall, where people pay tribute to this pioneer of modern enlightenment.
en.narrate: The Former Residence of Liang Qichao is located in Chakeng Village, Xinhui District, Jiangmen, Guangdong Province. Built during the Guangxu period of the Qing dynasty, it is a Lingnan dwelling of grey bricks and clay tiles, consisting of the residence, the Yitang Study and corridors, with a floor area of more than four hundred square meters. It is now a Major Historical and Cultural Site Protected at the National Level. Liang Qichao was a renowned modern Chinese thinker, politician, educator and writer. He led the Hundred Days' Reform together with Kang Youwei and wrote celebrated works such as The Youth of China. This is where he was born and grew up, and today the Liang Qichao Memorial Hall stands here in his memory.

spots.name: 开平立园
spots.location: 广东省江门市开平市塘口镇赓华村
spots.open_info: 开放时间以景区当日公告为准
spots.intro: 开平立园位于广东省开平市塘口镇赓华村，是旅美华侨谢维立于1926年至1936年历时十载兴建的私家园林，占地约一万一千平方米，融合中国传统园林与西洋建筑，被誉为“中国华侨园林一绝”。
spots.history: 立园主人谢维立早年赴美国谋生，事业有成后回乡建园。园林由别墅区、花园区等部分组成，园内泮立楼、泮文楼、乐天楼、毓培别墅等建筑，与亭台楼阁、小桥流水及罗马柱、彩色玻璃等西洋元素相互辉映，展现了华侨融汇中西的审美。如今立园是开平碉楼文化旅游区（国家5A级景区）的重要组成部分。
spots.narrate: 开平立园，位于广东省开平市塘口镇赓华村，是旅美华侨谢维立先生从1926年到1936年，历时十年兴建的私家园林，占地约一万一千平方米。它把中国传统的园林和西洋建筑巧妙地融合在一起，被誉为中国华侨园林一绝。园主人谢维立早年赴美国谋生，事业有成之后回乡建园。园里有别墅区、花园区，泮立楼、泮文楼、乐天楼、毓培别墅等建筑，和亭台楼阁、小桥流水以及罗马柱、彩色玻璃这些西洋元素相互辉映，展现了华侨融汇中西的审美。如今立园是开平碉楼文化旅游区的重要组成部分，这个文化旅游区是国家5A级景区。

en.name: Li Garden (Kaiping Li Garden)
en.location: Genghua Village, Tangkou Town, Kaiping, Jiangmen, Guangdong
en.open_info: Opening hours are subject to the scenic area's daily notice
en.intro: Li Garden is located in Genghua Village, Tangkou Town, Kaiping, Guangdong Province. It is a private garden built over ten years, from 1926 to 1936, by Xie Weili, an overseas Chinese who made his fortune in the United States. Covering about eleven thousand square meters, it blends traditional Chinese garden art with Western architecture and is praised as 'the finest garden of the overseas Chinese in China'.
en.history: The owner, Xie Weili, went to the United States in his early years and returned to build the garden after achieving success. The garden consists of a villa area and flower gardens, where buildings such as Panli Villa, Panwen Villa, Letian Tower and Yupei Villa are set off by pavilions, bridges and flowing water as well as Western elements such as Roman columns and stained glass, reflecting the overseas-Chinese taste for blending East and West. Today Li Garden is an important part of the Kaiping Diaolou Cultural Tourism Area, a National 5A Scenic Area.

The owner went to the United States in his early years and returned to build the garden after achieving success. The garden includes a villa area and flower gardens, where buildings such as Panli Villa, Panwen Villa, Letian Tower and Yupei Villa are set off by pavilions, bridges and flowing water as well as Western elements such as Roman columns and stained glass, reflecting the overseas-Chinese taste for blending East and West. Today Li Garden is an important part of the Kaiping Diaolou Cultural Tourism Area, a National 5A Scenic Area.
